purpose: personal account of Alexey shipping the DataTalks.Club Wrapped feature through phone-based review

required_facts.fact: Alexey merged a pull request into the DataTalks.Club course management platform.
required_facts.evidence: Source line 22: the merged PR and platform purpose are stated.

required_facts.fact: The PR added a Spotify Wrapped-style 2025 experience with community highlights, popular courses, top learners, and shareable participant pages.
required_facts.evidence: Source line 22: the feature contents are listed.

required_facts.fact: Most of the work happened on a smartphone while Alexey commuted to pick up his child.
required_facts.evidence: Source line 24: the phone and commute context are stated.

required_facts.fact: The idea came at a tram stop as a way to summarize learner achievements across the year's Zoomcamps.
required_facts.evidence: Source line 31: the setting and motivation are described.

required_facts.fact: Alexey dictated an issue into GitHub on his phone and assigned it to Copilot.
required_facts.evidence: Source line 33: voice input, GitHub, and Copilot are specified.

required_facts.fact: Copilot opened a pull request with working pages, code, and screenshots after about 20–30 minutes.
required_facts.evidence: Source line 33: the initial PR contents and time estimate are stated.

required_facts.fact: Alexey iterated by reviewing diffs on his phone, commenting, tagging Copilot, and reviewing each pushed version.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 42-44: the review-and-comment cycle is described.

required_facts.fact: Voice recognition changed 'top 100' into 'top 1200' in an early PR version.
required_facts.evidence: Source line 46: the transcription error and correction loop are explicit.

required_facts.fact: Copilot ran the project and attached UI screenshots, but missing internet access meant some styles did not load.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 49-51: screenshot generation and its limitation are described.

required_facts.fact: Copilot updates took about 10–30 minutes, while complex changes and final production approval remained laptop work; CI/CD deployed merged changes to a dev environment.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 58 and 63-65: timing, boundary, dev deployment, and production button are stated.

author_attribution: Attribute the feature, workflow, timing estimates, and judgments to Alexey's historical account; preserve the stated boundary around complex and production changes.
